title: Myth: Hinduism is Polytheistic
short: Reality: One Supreme Reality (Brahman) expressed in many forms.
description: Hinduism ultimately speaks of a single Supreme Reality, called Brahman, which manifests as various deities to aid different devotees in their spiritual path. Multiple forms are expressions of the same truth.

title: Myth: Idol Worship is Blind Faith
short: Reality: Idols help focus the mind during worship.
description: Idols are symbolic representations that help devotees concentrate and meditate on the divine. They are tools for spiritual focus, not objects of superstition.

title: Myth: Caste System is Core to Hinduism
short: Reality: Original Varna system was based on qualities, not birth.
description: Ancient Hindu texts describe Varna based on one's nature (Guna) and duties (Karma). Discrimination by birth is a later distortion, not part of true Sanatana Dharma.

title: Myth: Hinduism is Only Rituals
short: Reality: Its essence is self-realization and dharma.
description: While rituals exist, Hinduism emphasizes spiritual growth, self-realization, and living in harmony with dharma. Meditation, devotion, and righteous action are central practices.
